applicability.rationale: Patients were individually randomized 1:1 to parallel treatment groups by web-based application.

relation_rationale: Primary composite matches the requested event set and 24-month time point, compares randomized clopidogrel and aspirin assignment, and is analyzed by intention to treat; incomplete event-free follow-up is censored.

reported.analysis_population: All 5438 randomized patients in the ITT population; endpoint ascertainment was complete in 5338 (98.2%).

endpoint.definition: Composite of all-cause death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, stroke, readmission due to ACS, and major bleeding events (BARC type ≥3).
endpoint.name: Primary composite endpoint†

requested_outcome: Composite of all-cause death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, stroke, readmission for acute coronary syndrome, and BARC type 3 or greater bleeding

target.intended_analysis_population: All randomized participants in the comparison groups

measurement.method: Composite of all-cause death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, stroke, readmission due to acute coronary syndrome, and BARC type 3 or greater bleeding
measurement.metric: Composite of all-cause death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, stroke, readmission for acute coronary syndrome, and BARC type 3 or greater bleeding

target.outcome_definition: Composite of all-cause death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, stroke, readmission for acute coronary syndrome, and BARC type 3 or greater bleeding
